radiology_report:
Department of Radiology
UMCG (Groningen)
Date: 10 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 7.5 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 3+3. Evaluate for focal lesion.
FINDINGS: Prostate volume 42.0 mL. T2WI shows a focal hypointense lesion in the peripheral zone, mid left, measuring approximately 12 mm. DWI demonstrates restricted diffusion (high b-value signal, low ADC). Dynamic contrast enhancement shows early focal uptake. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion seen.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 4 lesion in peripheral zone, mid left. PSA density 0.179 ng/mL/mL. Clinical stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.0.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. Visser (GP)
previous_notes.text: 01 Sep 2023 - Dr. R. Visser (GP): Patient attended for routine follow-up. PSA was 4.3 ng/mL, showing a rise from previous levels. Discussed the need for further urological assessment. Referred to urology for biopsy evaluation.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (01 Sep 2023): Microscopic examination reveals benign prostatic tissue with focal adenocarcinoma. The carcinoma demonstrates an acinar growth pattern and is assigned a Gleason score of 3+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 1. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, mid left.

Summary: Histological findings across timepoints remain stable, with persistent ISUP grade group 1 disease.
